style: stylized 3D animated feature film look, soft subsurface skin shading, big expressive eyes, rounded appealing shapes, warm saturated color palette, global illumination with color bleeding, soft volumetric light, shallow depth of field with creamy bokeh, 24fps cinematic, vertical 9:16 composition
boy: an 8-year-old boy with curly chestnut-brown hair, freckles, big hazel eyes, a bright yellow raincoat and red rubber boots
robot: a small round robot the size of a basketball, rusty teal metal shell with dents, one large round glass eye that glows soft blue, stubby arms with three-finger grippers, a tiny folded propeller on top

shots.img: extreme close-up of a rain puddle in a junkyard at dusk, the reflection shows {robot} half-buried in scrap with its eye dark, and the reflected face of {boy} leaning in curiously, raindrops rippling the reflection
shots.move: raindrops hit the puddle, the robot's eye in the reflection flickers faintly blue once, slow push-in, eased motion

shots.img: {boy} crouching in a rainy junkyard, gently lifting {robot} out of a pile of scrap metal with both hands, warm light from a distant street lamp, cool blue rain, rim light on the raincoat
shots.move: the boy slowly lifts the robot and wipes rain off its glass eye with his sleeve, gentle crane up, raindrops falling

shots.img: cozy cluttered garage workshop at night, {boy} in pajamas with a screwdriver repairing {robot} on a wooden workbench under a warm desk lamp, tools, gears and a mug of cocoa, warm 3000K practical light, dust motes in the lamp beam
shots.move: the boy turns the screwdriver carefully, sparks pop softly, slow lateral tracking shot, dust motes drifting

shots.img: close-up of {robot} on the workbench in morning light, its glass eye lighting up bright blue for the first time, {boy} jumping back in surprise in the background, out of focus
shots.move: the robot's eye powers on with a soft glow and it blinks twice, the boy jumps back startled, rack focus from robot to boy

shots.img: sunny suburban backyard, {robot} hovering in the air with its tiny propeller spinning, {boy} laughing and running underneath with arms raised, autumn leaves swirling, golden-hour light
shots.move: the robot loops in the air and the boy runs after it laughing, leaves swirl, camera orbits slowly, eased motion

shots.img: messy family kitchen, {robot} standing on the counter flipping pancakes with a frying pan, pancakes flying through the air, flour everywhere, {boy} ducking with a surprised grin
shots.move: a pancake flips high and lands on the boy's head, flour puffs, comedic timing, static camera with slight push-in

shots.img: {boy} and {robot} sitting side by side on a house rooftop at sunset, the robot projecting tiny glowing stars from its eye into the purple sky, warm orange rim light, soft clouds
shots.move: tiny projected stars float upward and twinkle, the boy rests his head against the robot, slow crane up and back, peaceful

shots.img: cozy dark bedroom at night, {boy} asleep in bed, {robot} gently pulling the blanket over him, its eye glowing soft dim blue like a night light, moonlight through the window
shots.move: the robot tucks the blanket, then turns to the camera and its eye winks once, gentle push-in, soft breathing motion
